items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: I did the Della Reese Show for a year.

ctx.x: Sure. But then I would do record dates all the time. Then I started doing the -- I did the Della Reese Show for a year. Then I did the Frank Sinatra Show -- he had a show at one time. And Rosemary Clooney did two years of shows, Roosemary Clooney Show. Then with Nelson. Then I did the Bill Cosby Show. I did Leslie Uggams Show. I did the Don Knotts Show. I did the Don Rickles Show.
Did you save money during this time or were you living it up?
